rules.rationale: Base equation for the declarative scanGroups fold: consuming an empty suffix returns the accumulated output sequence.
Recursive scanGroups equation defining that a space is ignored while the current group, depth, and accumulator are preserved.
Recursive scanGroups equation for an opening parenthesis, defining current-group extension and depth increment.
Owise structural dispatch equation completing scanGroups by delegating its remaining character case to the scanClose helper.
Conditional scanClose equation defining the group-completion case: reset current/depth and append the completed group when closing reaches depth zero.
Complementary scanClose recurrence defining a nested close that extends the current group and decrements depth without emitting a group.
Base equation defining balancedTail on an empty suffix as exactly the zero-final-depth condition.
Recursive balancedTail equation defining spaces as depth-neutral and ignored by the contract predicate.
Recursive balancedTail equation defining an opening parenthesis as increasing the tracked depth.
Recursive balancedTail equation defining the remaining character case as a closing parenthesis with a positive-depth guard and depth decrement.
Base equation defining the empty code sequence to satisfy the parenthesis-or-space alphabet predicate.
Recursive parenSpaceOnly equation defining the accepted character codes and recurring over the remaining sequence.
Macro expansion defining the named solutionClosure proof term as the exact translated function closure; it introduces no execution fact.
